limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Compactness/weak compactness and the essential-norm threshold are classical prior art and are not claimed as new. The claimed contribution is the exact simultaneous approximation/Bernstein/Gelfand/Kolmogorov profile, the exact distances to weakly compact, finitely strictly singular and strictly singular classes, and the quantitative isometric c0 witness. The Singh--Singh 1995 survey, Singh--Manhas 1993 monograph, and full Takagi--Miura--Takahasi 2003 paper were not exhaustively inspected, and older disjointness-preserver literature remains a residual risk.
provenance: Finite-rank interpolation on the finitely many high-weight image fibers gives the upper approximation bound. Pairwise separated peak functions at distinct image points give matching finite-dimensional lower witnesses for approximation, Bernstein, Gelfand and Kolmogorov numbers. Below the limiting threshold, countably many disjoint peak functions form an isometric c0 copy on which the weighted composition operator is bounded below, giving the singular-ideal distance formulas.
record_title: Exact s-number profiles for weighted composition operators on C(K)-spaces
